item.title: U&lc magazine
item.description: I have 40 copies of U&lc magazine, ranging from Voume 4, #4 (December, 1977) through Volume 19, #1 (Spring 1992). I can’t bring myself to throw them out. Do they have any value? Is anyone interested in them?
